caption_fb:
Opłatek (oh-PWAH-tek): the wafer that starts Wigilia (vee-GHEEL-yah).

Before Christmas Eve supper, Polish families share a thin, blessed wafer. Each person breaks a piece from someone else's and offers a wish for the coming year: health, forgiveness, good things.

It's often the most emotional moment of the evening.

This Wigilia, the table may hold more of your family's story than any archive.

Does your family still share opłatek? 👇
